Q: unable to read parquet files from directory with pyarrow A:

I just encountered this issue when passing a list of filepaths to pandas.read_parquet when the list only contained a single entry.

>>> import pandas as pd
>>> files = ["file1.parquet", "file2.parquet"]
>>> pd.read_parquet(files)      # OK
>>> pd.read_parquet(files[:1])  # ValueError: cannot construct a FileSource from a path without a FileSystem
>>> pd.read_parquet(files[0])   # OK

Q: Singleton vs Static FUNCTIONS A:

A static function itself cannot play the role of singleton. None of your examples represents a singleton. This way, this question makes no sense.

Q: Is there a way to store actual data in Qrcode? A:

Much of the information you're looking for appears to be easily found by searching.

What you're asking now is different from what you asked in the question above. But the answer is pretty similar. Current defined standards for QR codes have defined limits in the amount of data they can hold. You can of course expand on those standards for your own needs, but should expect to have to customize any libraries you use because there'd be no expectation of standard libraries supporting your custom needs.
